# Aperture built-in looks (presets)

- Kind: `editor`
- Category: `photo`
- Slug: `photo/presets`

## Summary

The built-in looks. Applying a look appends its layers on top of the user's edits, grouped under "Preset: <name>"; undo removes it. Users can also save their own presets.
